subject: Dedicated capacity expansion: sizing, pricing and addendum options
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@fastretail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need pricing for mid-term GPU add / throughput guarantees

Hi Tessa,

Were planning to increase our Dedicated pool for the holiday spike and are exploring two paths: (A) a short-term add-on of 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for 4 months, or (B) a permanent increase of 12 GPUs rolled into our next 12-month commit at renewal.

Key asks:
- Ballpark monthly/annual pricing for both options and any prepay / discount thresholds.
- Throughput guarantees (95th pctl latency / tokens-per-second) or SLA credit language for committed pools.
- How burst capacity works if we hit transient higher traffic.

We can share utilization if that helps. Procurement timeline is tight: want pricing + contract path by 9/10.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of ML Ops
Fast Retail
[Attachment: usage_snapshot_Aug2026.csv (24KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@fastretail.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need pricing for mid-term GPU add / throughput guarantees

Hi Olivia 

Thanks for the context and the usage snapshot (attached). We can support both approaches; below are two pragmatic options with the economics and operational tradeoffs:

Option A Short-term add-on (4 months)
- 8 A100-equivalent GPUs, billed monthly as an addendum.
- Pricing: $28k / GPU / month list; we can offer a 8% uplift discount for short-term add-ons when purchased as a block.
- No long-term commit; burst access is available up to +40% capacity for 48-hour windows (subject to regional availability).
- SLA: standard hosted SLA does not apply to ephemeral add-ons; we offer best-effort support and a 4-hour response for severity-1.

Option B Permanent increase rolled into commit (12 months)
- 12 GPUs added to your reserved pool.
- Pricing: $22k / GPU / month list (committed rate).
- Discount tiers: 12-month prepay = additional 12% off committed rates; 24-month = 18% off.
- SLA: 99.9% availability target for committed pools; credits available up to 10% of monthly invoice for SLA miss.
- Burst policy: guaranteed baseline throughput; ephemeral burst available with 10% overage charge or on negotiated burst schedule.

What I need from your side to firm numbers:
- 95th percentile token/sec and peak concurrency for the two busiest days (sample in CSV helps).
- Preference on prepay vs monthly billing and desired start date (mid-Sep / Oct).

Ive attached a preliminary quote v1 (numbers are estimates) and can get a formal addendum ready once we agree on the option. If useful, I can loop in finance for a quick approval path. Happy to set up a 30-min call tomorrow.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0126
[Attachment: prelim_quote_v1.pdf]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@fastretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need pricing for mid-term GPU add / throughput guarantees

Thanks Tessa 

Quick answers and a bit more detail from our side:
- Attached sample + 7-day peak window (UTC timestamps). 95th pctl token/sec ~ 4.1M across the busiest hour; peak concurrency 220.
- Preferred timeline: start add-on 2026-10-01 if we go short-term. If committing to 12 months, start date aligned to renewal 2027-01-01.
- Procurement note: we prefer price caps rather than open overage terms. Would you be able to provide a capped per-token rate for committed pools?

Also: procurement will need a formal addendum plus copy of SLA language for legal review. Target to get signed by 9/10 if possible.

Olivia
[Attachment: FastRetail_usage_7day_peak.csv (48KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: internal@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Fast Retail - discount / capped pricing approval request (RF-2026-4529)

Rafael / Neha,

Summary: Fast Retail sent usage (95th pctl ~4.1M tps, peak concurrency 220). They're evaluating: (A) 8-GPU short add-on for 4 months starting 10/1, or (B) 12-GPU permanent commit rolled into a 12-month renewal starting 1/1. Procurement wants a price cap for committed pools and fresh SLA language.

Proposed commercial levers:
- Approve up to 18% discount on committed 12-mo prepay (list $22k/GPU/mo -> net $18.04k) if they prepay 12 months upfront and include a 12-GPU bump.
- Alternatively, approve 10% discount for a 6-month committed add-on with a renewal opt-in clause.
- For short-term 4-month add-ons, offer an 8% block discount off list; no SLA credits.
- For price cap: offer a capped per-token rate of $0.00018 per token for committed pools (12-mo) up to the observed 95th pctl; overages billed at 1.25x the cap.

Risks / notes:
- 18% prepay reduces gross revenue materially but secures a multi-year relationship; need finance ok on P&L.
- SLA credits up to 10% of invoice is standard; consider reducing to 5% for promotional commit to protect downside.

Request: Rafael - approve discount band and cap language so I can push to procurement. Neha - can you confirm if legal needs any modified SLA verbiage beyond our standard addendum?

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@fastretail.com>, procurement@fastretail.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need pricing for mid-term GPU add / throughput guarantees

Hi Olivia 

Appreciate the usage file and timeline. Per internal confirmation, here are the actionable options and next steps so procurement has firm language for review:

Option 1 Short add-on (4 months)
- 8 A100-equivalent GPUs
- Rate: $25,760 / GPU / month (8% block discount off list)
- No SLA credits; 48-hour burst policy up to +40% subject to regional capacity.
- Start: 2026-10-01 (can provision within 5 business days of signed addendum).

Option 2 Committed increase (12 months, start 2027-01-01)
- 12 GPUs added to reserved pool
- Net rate (12-mo prepay): $18,040 / GPU / month (18% off committed list)
- Capped per-token rate: $0.00018 up to 95th pctl observed (4.1M tps); overage billed at 1.25x cap.
- SLA: 99.9% availability target; credits up to 10% monthly for SLA miss.

Procurement-ready items attached: formal addendum v2, summary table, and a DocuSign link for the addendum if the team is ready.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which option you prefer (A or B) by EOD 9/10 so we can route the DocuSign.
2) If Option B, procurement: please confirm prepay cadence and PO details; we will route to finance for prepay invoice.

Links / attachments:
- Addendum (proposed): https://docusign.com/transaction/ABC12345
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4529
- Attachment: FastRetail_Dedicated_Addendum_v2.pdf

If helpful Im available for a 20-min call this afternoon to walk the legal team through the SLA language.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0126
[Attachment: FastRetail_Dedicated_Addendum_v2.pdf (92KB)]
